newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Mississippi $140 mln GO bonds.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Mississippi $140 mln GO bonds.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the State Bond Commission (the State Bond Commission'') of the State of Mississippi (the State'') will receive sealed bids at the offices of the Department of Finance and Administration, 901 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson, Mississippi 39201, until 11:00 o'clock a.m., Mississippi time, on the
for the purchase at not less than par plus accrued interest to the date of delivery of $140,505,000 General Obligation Bonds (Capital Improvements Issue), Series 1997A (the
Bonds'') of the State. The Bonds are being issued for the purpose of financing the costs of certain capital

improvements within the State and the payment of the costs incident to the sale, issuance and delivery of the Bonds. The Bonds shall be general obligations of the State and the full faith, credit and taxing power of the State shall be pledged to secure the payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds. The Bonds will be dated and bear interest from July 1, 1997, will mature on July 1 of each year beginning July 1, 1998 through July 1, 2017, will be payable as to interest on January 1 and July 1 of each year, commencing January 1, 1998, and will be delivered in definitive form as fully registered Bonds. The Bonds will be subject to redemption prior to their respective maturities at the option of the State, on and after July 1, 2007 and without premium, as more particularly described in the State's Preliminary Official Statement dated June 19, 1997 relating to the Bonds (the Preliminary Official Statement''). The complete Notice of Bond Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and an Official Bid Form on which all bids must be submitted and further information concerning the Bonds may be obtained from the Office of the State Treasurer, 404 Walter Sillers Building, 550 High Street, Jackson,
Mississippi 39201, telephone: (601) 359-3600, attention: Ms. Liz Majure or from the Office of the Department of Finance and Administration, Bond Division, 906 Walter Sillers

Building, 550 High Street, Jackson, Mississippi, 39201, telephone: (601) 359-3433, attention: Ms. Mary Keen. Bidders may not rely on this Summary Notice of Bond Sale as providing complete information concerning the Bonds.
